data.title: One real attempt. Burned.
data.kicker: Testing a kid's tasks meant running them for real

data.statement: No way to test a fix safely

beats.note: Timeline archetype's final node lights up; result card ticks 1 -> 0 real rows mid-beat with a continuing pulse, plus a LogWindow result panel built from the feature's own numbers (0 real rows touched, speed slider tested 0.5x-1.3x before saving) — never the feature page or the hub.

reshoot_2026-11-08: Viewer scored clarity 6/10 on the 2026-11-07 cut. Fixes: (1) b1 opener was quoteMarker, a forbidden recent opener (g22) — swapped to titleTakeover; (2) b2/b4 showed the features HUB scrolling past unrelated feature cards (kiosk calendar, glucose chart, etc) as 'evidence' with nothing to do with the sentence — replaced with the feature's own page, shallow scroll for b2 (still problem-framed) and a deep scroll for b4 (the actual fix paragraph); (3) b3 and b1 previously shared one aggressive scroll curve that both independently drifted into the solution paragraph mid-beat while the caption still narrated the problem — b1-b3 now use separate shots capped at a shallow scroll band (0-640px) so the solution paragraph only appears at b4; (4) b5's result card held static for ~160 frames after its lines finished — added a 1->0 tick and a continuing pulse through the final frame.
